entries.desc: A project with doneRequiredCommands normalizes required command entries without changing ordinary validate.commands behavior.

evidence.note: Config schema and normalization implemented in core/config.ts and core/done-required-validation.ts; smoke proves configured policy normalizes separately from ordinary validate.commands.

entries.desc: A project without doneRequiredCommands remains valid and exposes no blocking DONE-required policy.

evidence.note: Smoke proves projects without doneRequiredCommands render advisory/non-blocking DONE-required status.

entries.desc: Malformed opted-in doneRequiredCommands fail closed with a precise configuration error rather than silently becoming advisory.

evidence.note: Process-fact verifier pins malformed opted-in policy fail-closed semantics through done_required_validate policy/contract tokens.

entries.desc: done_required_validate executes the configured required commands and writes done-required-evidence.json with PASS receipts, output digests, and bounded output tails.

evidence.note: Smoke exercises done_required_validate runner writing done-required-evidence.json with PASS receipts for configured required commands.

entries.desc: A failing required command writes a FAIL artifact with command identity, exit code, digest/tail, and does not look like PASS evidence.

evidence.note: Smoke runs a failing required command and asserts a FAIL artifact with exit code and blocking evaluation.

entries.desc: Root npm test cannot satisfy self-host full assurance unless a preceding same-material packages/main build receipt or equivalent build proof exists.

evidence.note: Smoke proves root npm test receipt without preceding same-material packages/main build proof is rejected with missing-build-proof.

entries.desc: DONE checklist renders a separate done-required-validation row that passes when fresh required evidence matches current material and policy.

evidence.note: Smoke verifies a fresh PASS done-required-evidence.json makes the dedicated DONE-required row pass.

entries.desc: Projects without a required DONE policy render an advisory/non-blocking row and do not block DONE solely for missing done-required evidence.

evidence.note: Smoke verifies projects without a required policy render advisory/non-blocking DONE-required status.

entries.desc: Self-host required policy blocks DONE on missing, failing, stale material, stale storyFilesHash, or changed command/policy evidence.

evidence.note: Smoke verifies required policy blocks on missing artifact, failing artifact, stale material, policy drift, command-set drift, and missing build proof.

entries.desc: process-fact registry, levels, and verifier include done_required_validate and done-required-evidence.json as L4 DONE gate evidence.

evidence.note: Verifier confirms done_required_validate and artifact:done-required-evidence.json are registered as L4 gate evidence with required semantics.

entries.desc: The contract verifier fails if the DONE-required artifact or command policy is removed or downgraded from gate evidence semantics.

evidence.note: Verifier has targeted assertions for command policy, registry artifact path, semantic facts, and oracle row tokens so removal/downgrade fails the contract.

entries.desc: The new fact registration must not claim Authority receipt completion, productionDone, or release approval semantics.

evidence.note: Verifier and command policy assert no Authority receipt completion, productionDone, release approval, or remote publish claim for done_required_validate.

entries.desc: Smoke coverage proves ordinary validate.commands can pass while DONE-required failure still blocks DONE for required policy.

evidence.note: Smoke proves ordinary test-evidence PASS can coexist with missing DONE-required artifact that blocks required policy.

entries.desc: Smoke coverage proves missing artifact, stale material/policy/command-set, and missing build receipt are each rejected with explicit reasons.

evidence.note: Smoke covers missing artifact, stale material, policy drift, command-set drift, and missing build receipt rejection.

entries.desc: Smoke coverage proves an external project without doneRequiredCommands gets only advisory/non-blocking DONE-required status.

evidence.note: Smoke covers fixture project without doneRequiredCommands and asserts advisory/non-blocking DONE-required row.

entries.desc: Lifecycle/testing docs clearly distinguish ordinary lattice validate evidence from DONE-required full-suite evidence.

evidence.note: Docs distinguish lattice validate as routine TEST evidence from done_required_validate as separate DONE-required evidence.

entries.desc: Docs state external projects without doneRequiredCommands are advisory/non-blocking by default.

evidence.note: Docs state external projects without doneRequiredCommands are advisory/non-blocking and must not claim full-suite assurance.

entries.desc: Docs do not imply release_approve_push, pre-push, Authority, or production receipt behavior was implemented in this story.

evidence.command: git diff --name-only main...HEAD | rg "^(\.githooks/pre-push|packages/main/src/handlers/release|packages/main/src/.+authority|packages/main/src/core/.+authority)" && exit 1 || echo "no release/pre-push/authority implementation files changed"
evidence.note: Changed docs explicitly say this story does not implement release approval, pre-push, Authority, or production receipt behavior; changed-file check confirms those implementation surfaces were not touched.

entries.desc: The self-host repository config opts into a required DONE policy with packages/main build before root npm test or equivalent same-material build proof.

evidence.command: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\"); const cfg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"lattice.config.json\",\"utf8\")); if(!Array.isArray(cfg.doneRequiredCommands)||cfg.doneRequiredCommands.length!==2) throw new Error(\"doneRequiredCommands missing\"); const a=cfg.doneRequiredCommands[0], b=cfg.doneRequiredCommands[1]; if(a.command!==\"npm\"||a.args.join(\" \")!==\"--prefix packages/main run build\") throw new Error(\"missing packages/main build first\"); if(b.command!==\"npm\"||b.args.join(\" \")!==\"test\") throw new Error(\"missing root npm test second\"); console.log(\"self-host doneRequiredCommands config ok\");"
evidence.note: Self-host lattice.config.json opts into DONE-required policy with packages/main build before root npm test.

entries.desc: Self-host policy configuration does not alter ordinary validate.commands and does not make external projects blocking by default.

evidence.command: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\"); const cfg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"lattice.config.json\",\"utf8\")); const validate=(cfg.validate&&cfg.validate.commands)||[]; if(validate.some(x=>typeof x===\"string\"?x===\"npm test\":x.command===\"npm\"&&Array.isArray(x.args)&&x.args.join(\" \")===\"test\")) throw new Error(\"root npm test leaked into validate.commands\"); console.log(\"validate.commands unchanged by full-suite requirement\");" && node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js
evidence.note: Root npm test is not in ordinary validate.commands; smoke proves external projects without policy remain advisory/non-blocking.

entries.desc: The self-host config item does not modify release_approve_push, .githooks/pre-push, or Authority production receipt behavior.

evidence.command: git diff --name-only main...HEAD | rg "^(\.githooks/pre-push|packages/main/src/handlers/release|packages/main/src/.+authority|packages/main/src/core/.+authority)" && exit 1 || echo "no release/pre-push/authority implementation files changed"
evidence.note: Self-host config change did not touch release_approve_push, pre-push hook, or Authority production receipt implementation files.
